scope: Read-only recursive inventory of the named local folder, native text extraction and targeted rendered term/signature/page review against inherited conversation and retrieved dossier. Not a legal enforceability determination or full clause review.

method.inventory: SHA256 over complete original bytes; all 47 originals unchanged.
method.extraction: Bundled pypdf; native extraction coverage classified per page. Poppler renders; Tesseract OCR of 183 selected pages plus visual page and contact-sheet review.
method.signature_limit: Visible marks/blank fields assessed. No forensic signature authentication, cryptographic certificate validation, authority opinion, or legal conclusion.
method.negative_search_limit: Not located applies only to this folder and this review; never confirmed absent.
method.historical_vs_current: Historical lease existence does not establish current renewal or operating state.
method.date_locator: All page locators are physical one-based PDF pages, not printed document page numbers.

privacy.reason: Lease/guaranty/ACH originals include signatures, personal identifiers, addresses and bank authorization material. Folder totals ~153.06 MiB. Include audit, exact pointers and hashes; request originals in a private authorized session as needed.
